prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
A good starting point is **Shere’s Construction & Handyman** for a mix of remodeling and repair work. The Better Business Bureau lists it as accredited with an **A+ rating**, and its listed services include kitchen and bathroom updates, drywall, flooring, painting, decks, and general repairs. Call **(417) 385-8899**. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/general-contractor/sheres-construction-handyman-0734-1000009996)

For a larger remodel, **American Construction Inc.** is another local option; it says it has served Joplin since 1993 and handles remodels and other construction work. Call **(417) 781-6811**. [Company website](https://www.americanconstructionincorporated.com/)

These are leads, not guarantees. Before hiring, get at least two written, itemized bids; ask for recent references and proof of liability insurance and workers’ compensation; and agree in writing on scope, schedule, payment milestones, and how changes will be priced.
